To the community and the creators of the game

I love this game, but it’s hard to get characters, especially if you’re new. Sure, being new has its advantages, but what if a new player doesn't have much free time or can't play all day to farm the crystals needed to get a character? So my genuine recommendation for you is:

For limited pulls, play the story. There is just no better source of silver at the start. Not only that, iirc you get aurita, erica and aigis for absolutely free pretty early (so that you can test the other realms)

But for standard characters, you can:
Level a character past 10 and then past 20, each give you a roll and is prety cheap.

Play through the story, as each level gives you a full roll, even if it's just story.

And if you haven't yet, pretty soon you'll unlock the side stories. Every 3 days logged in you can unlock a side story, and some of them have no actual fights.

What i've been doing to get rolls is: skip the entire story, specially on those side chapters. Once you clear a chapter of whatever it is, it unlocks a "story mode" in which you can replay just the cutscenes and interaction in order. That way you can get what you want now and pick up where you left off once you have time to do so!
(which is probably one of my favorite things of this game, the time i have to play does not need to overlap with the time i have to enjoy the story)
